Researchers were cautious because the study was small.

Conjunctive adverbs

Como:

however

therefore

moreover

consequently.

Frequentemente:

sentence. Connector, sentence.

Exemplo:

The study was small. However, the results were interesting.

Connector no início

However, more research is needed.

Therefore, the program will continue.

In addition, students receive materials.

A vírgula após o conector é muito comum.

Because não exige vírgula automaticamente

We stayed home because it was raining.

Mas:

Because it was raining, we stayed home.

Quando a oração causal vem primeiro:

usamos normalmente vírgula.

Although

Although the sample was small, the results were useful.

Ou:

The results were useful although the sample was small.

Because of + noun

Because of the storm, the flight was canceled.

Despite + noun

Despite the storm, the flight departed.

Observe a diferença semântica:

because of → causa.

despite → concessão.

Relação implícita

Às vezes não há conector.

The road was flooded. The bus service stopped.

A relação mais provável:

cause → effect.

Em uma questão, você pode precisar identificar:

why.

Escolha do conector pela lógica

Considere:

The course was expensive. ______, more than 500 students enrolled.

Qual faz sentido?

However.

Porque há contraste:

expensive

mas:

many students enrolled.

Não:

therefore

porque preço alto não explica naturalmente:

more enrollment.

Outro exemplo

The course was free. ______, many people applied.

Aqui:

therefore

ou:

as a result

pode fazer sentido.

Predicting

Conectores permitem prever o que vem depois.

However…

Espere:

contraste.

For example…

Espere:

exemplo.

Therefore…

Espere:

consequência/conclusão.

Although…

Espere:

informação contrastante.

Because…

Espere:

causa.

Isso ajuda no Reading mesmo antes de entender cada palavra.

Conector como pista de resposta

Texto:

The device is inexpensive. However, it is less accurate than professional equipment.

Pergunta:

What disadvantage is mentioned?

O:

however

sinaliza que a resposta provavelmente vem:

depois dele.

Main idea e contrast markers

Texto:

Online learning offers flexibility. However, some students find it difficult to stay motivated.

Se uma questão pede resumo, uma resposta equilibrada deve incluir:

benefit + challenge.

Scientific caution + contrast

The results were promising. However, the sample was small.

A segunda frase:

limita a primeira.

Não ignore informações depois de:

however

but

although.

Elas frequentemente são importantes em questões.

Conectores em notícias

The road was closed because of flooding. As a result, several bus routes were changed.

Causa:

flooding.

Primeira consequência:

road closed.

Segunda consequência:

routes changed.

Cadeia causal

Podemos ter:

A causes B → B causes C.

Exemplo:

Heavy rain caused flooding. The flooding closed several roads. As a result, traffic delays increased.

Scientific texts

Participants in the exercise group performed better. However, the researchers noted that the sample was small. Therefore, further research is needed.

Relações:

result

→ however → limitation

→ therefore → consequence/conclusion.

Texto argumentativo

Public transport can reduce traffic. In addition, it can lower pollution levels. However, improving transport systems can be expensive. Nevertheless, long-term benefits may justify the investment.

Observe:

addition

contrast

concession.

Nevertheless

Significa:

mesmo assim / no entanto.

É mais formal.

Exemplo:

The project was expensive. Nevertheless, officials decided to continue it.

Still

Também pode indicar concessão:

The evidence is limited. Still, the results are interesting.

Yet

Pode funcionar como:

but/nevertheless.

The system is simple, yet effective.

While x whereas

Compare:

While online classes offer flexibility, face-to-face classes provide more direct interaction.

Online classes offer flexibility, whereas face-to-face classes provide more direct interaction.

Ambos podem mostrar:

contraste.

Since: armadilha

I’ve lived here since 2022.

Temporal.

Since the bus was late, I took a taxi.

Causal.

Sempre use:

contexto.

As: múltiplos sentidos

As I was leaving, the phone rang.

Temporal:

enquanto.

As the weather was bad, we stayed home.

Causal:

porque.

As a teacher, she works with children.

Função:

como.

Portanto:

não traduza automaticamente.

So: múltiplos usos

Resultado:

I was tired, so I went home.

Intensificador:

It was so difficult.

Substituição:

I think so.

O contexto determina.

Then

Sequência:

We ate dinner, then we left.

Também pode aparecer em conditionals:

If that’s true, then we need another plan.

For

Em registro mais formal/literário, for pode significar:

because.

Mas isso é menos prioritário no B1.

Therefore x because

Erro frequente:

Because the road was flooded, therefore the service stopped.

Evite duplicar a ligação em uma estrutura simples.

Use:

Because the road was flooded, the service stopped.

Ou:

The road was flooded. Therefore, the service stopped.

Although x however

Errado:

Although the project was expensive. However, it continued.

As duas palavras podem aparecer em estruturas maiores, mas não precisam ser usadas para marcar exatamente o mesmo contraste dessa maneira.

Forma simples:

Although the project was expensive, it continued.

Ou:

The project was expensive. However, it continued.

Because x because of

Errado:

because of it was raining.

Correto:

because it was raining.

Ou:

because of the rain.

Despite x although

Errado:

Despite it was raining…

Correto:

Although it was raining…

Ou:

Despite the rain…

In spite of

In spite of being tired, she completed the task.

Due to

Errado em exercícios básicos:

due to the weather was bad.

Correto:

due to bad weather.

For example x such as

Compare:

Many renewable sources are available. For example, solar power is widely used.

Renewable sources such as solar and wind power are widely used.

For example pode introduzir uma frase inteira.

Such as normalmente introduz:

exemplos dentro da estrutura da frase.

Conector e paráfrase

Em Reading:

due to = because of

therefore = as a result

nevertheless = however/even so

in addition = furthermore/moreover

for instance = for example

provided that = as long as, em vários contextos

despite = in spite of.

Nem sempre são totalmente intercambiáveis

Embora dois conectores tenham significado próximo:

estrutura gramatical

e:

registro

podem mudar.

Exemplo:

because + clause.

because of + noun.

Logical relation questions

Formulações:

What is the relationship between paragraphs 2 and 3?

Why does the writer use “however”?

What does “therefore” indicate?

Which connector could replace “because of”?

Which word best completes the gap?

Relação entre parágrafos

P2:

descreve benefícios.

P3 começa:

However…

Então:

P3 introduces a contrasting limitation.

Gap filling

Exemplo:

The technology is inexpensive. ______, it is not yet accurate enough for professional use.

Resposta:

However.

Causa

The event was canceled ______ heavy rain.

Resposta:

because of / due to.

Clause

The event was canceled ______ it was raining heavily.

Resposta:

because.

Concessão

______ the rain, the event continued.

Resposta:

Despite / In spite of.

Clause concessiva

______ it was raining, the event continued.

Resposta:

Although / Even though.

Resultado

It was raining heavily. ______, the event was canceled.

Resposta:

Therefore / As a result / Consequently.

Addition

The program reduced costs. ______, it improved efficiency.

Resposta:

In addition / Moreover / Furthermore.

Exemplo

Several activities can improve health, ______ walking and swimming.

Resposta:

such as.

Vocabulário-chave

connector — conector

linking word — palavra de ligação

addition — adição

contrast — contraste

cause — causa

consequence — consequência

result — resultado

purpose — finalidade

condition — condição

concession — concessão

example — exemplo

sequence — sequência

comparison — comparação

conclusion — conclusão

however — porém/no entanto

therefore — portanto

although — embora

despite — apesar de

because of — por causa de

as a result — como resultado

in addition — além disso

for example — por exemplo

Estratégia de prova

Quando encontrar um conector, classifique mentalmente a relação.

and / in addition → + information

but / however → contrast

because / due to → cause

so / therefore → result

for example / such as → example

although / despite → concession

if / unless → condition

first / then / finally → sequence

Depois leia:

o que aparece antes

e:

o que aparece depois.

Isso permite reconstruir a lógica mesmo quando há palavras desconhecidas.

Em questões de lacuna, siga esta ordem:

1. Qual é a relação lógica entre as ideias?

2. O conector exige clause ou noun phrase?

3. A pontuação está adequada?

4. O registro é compatível?

Não escolha apenas pela tradução.

Prática

1. Complete:

The course is expensive. ______, it is very popular.

  1. Therefore
  2. However
  3. Because
  4. For example

2. Complete:

  1. because
  2. because of
  3. despite
  4. therefore

  1. because
  2. because of

  4. so that

4. Complete:

  1. For example
  2. As a result
  3. Although
  4. In addition to because

5. Complete:

______ the weather was bad, the event continued.

  1. Because
  2. Although
  3. Therefore
  4. Because of

6. Complete:

______ the bad weather, the event continued.

  1. Although
  2. Despite
  3. Because
  4. Therefore

7. Complete:

The university added more computers. ______, it extended library opening hours.

  1. In addition
  2. However
  3. Because
  4. Despite

8. Complete:

  1. because
  2. such as
  3. therefore
  4. although

9. Complete:

  1. because
  2. to

  4. so

10. Complete:

  1. so that
  2. despite

11. Escolha a frase correta:

  1. Because of it was raining, we stayed home.
  2. Because it was raining, we stayed home.
  3. Because the rain was, we stayed home.
  4. Therefore it was raining because we stayed home.

12. Escolha:

  1. Despite she was tired, she continued.
  2. Although she was tired, she continued.
  3. Although her tiredness, she continued.
  4. Despite she continued because tired.

13. Escolha:

  1. Despite the rain, the match continued.
  2. Although the rain, the match continued.
  3. Because the rain, the match continued unexpectedly.
  4. However the rain, the match continued.

14. Complete:

The results were promising. ______, the sample was small.

  1. However
  2. Therefore
  3. For example
  4. Because

15. Complete:

The sample was very small. ______, further research is needed.

  1. For instance
  2. Therefore
  3. Although
  4. Meanwhile

16. Identifique a relação:

The course is free. In addition, all materials are provided.

  1. contrast
  2. addition
  3. cause
  4. condition

17. Identifique:

Although the technology is useful, it is expensive.

  1. concession/contrast
  2. sequence
  3. example
  4. result

18. Identifique:

The flight was delayed due to fog.

  1. cause
  2. example
  3. addition
  4. conclusion

19. Identifique:

The roads were flooded. Consequently, several schools closed.

  1. cause introduced after result
  2. consequence/result
  3. example
  4. comparison

20. Identifique:

If the weather improves, the event will take place outside.

  1. condition
  2. contrast
  3. addition
  4. exemplification

21. Corrija:

Although the course was difficult, but I completed it.

22. Corrija:

The flight was canceled because of the weather was bad.

23. Corrija:

Despite it was raining, we went out.

24. Corrija:

The results were positive, however more research is necessary.

Use pontuação formal adequada.

25. Reescreva mantendo o significado:

The match was canceled because it was raining heavily.

Use:

because of.

26. Reescreva:

Although the program was expensive, the city continued it.

Use:

despite.

27. Reescreva:

The road was closed because of flooding.

Use:

therefore.

28. Complete o texto:

The new bus system has several advantages. ______, buses arrive more frequently than before. ______, ticket prices have been reduced. ______, some passengers still complain about overcrowding during peak hours. The city plans to add more buses ______ reduce this problem.

Use:

for example / in addition / however / to

uma vez cada.

29. Leia:

A study found that students who took regular breaks performed slightly better on a concentration task. However, the researchers noted that the sample included only 60 participants. Therefore, they recommended conducting a larger study before drawing strong conclusions.

Responda:

  1. What relation does however introduce?

  2. What relation does therefore introduce?

  3. What is the limitation?

  4. What is the consequence of that limitation?

30. Produção

Escreva um texto de 130 a 160 palavras sobre:

Advantages and challenges of online education

Use obrigatoriamente:

  • in addition;
  • however;
  • because ou because of;
  • therefore ou as a result;
  • although;
  • for example;
  • if;
  • in conclusion.

Gabarito comentado

1. B — However

Temos contraste:

expensive

mas:

popular.

2. A — because

Depois vem uma oração:

it was raining.

Logo:

because + clause.

3. B — because of

Depois vem:

the rain

uma noun phrase.

4. B — As a result

Flooding leva a:

bus delays.

Logo:

consequência.

5. B — Although

Estrutura:

although + subject + verb.

6. B — Despite

Estrutura:

despite + noun phrase.

7. A — In addition

A segunda informação:

acrescenta outro serviço.

8. B — such as

Introduz exemplos.

9. B — to

to study

expressa:

purpose.

10. A — so that

so that + clause

indica finalidade.

11. B

because + clause.

12. B

although + clause.

13. A

despite + noun.

14. A — However

Resultados positivos:

contrasted with

limitação da amostra.

15. B — Therefore

A amostra pequena leva à conclusão:

further research needed.

16. B — addition

in addition

marca informação adicional.

17. A

although

18. A

due to fog

20. A

if

introduz condição.

21.

Although the course was difficult, I completed it.

Ou:

The course was difficult, but I completed it.

Não precisamos usar:

although + but

na mesma estrutura básica.

22.

The flight was canceled because the weather was bad.

Ou:

The flight was canceled because of the bad weather.

23.

Although it was raining, we went out.

Ou:

Despite the rain, we went out.

24.

Ou:

25.

Mudança:

because + clause

→

26.

Ou:

A primeira é mais natural.

27.

Agora:

cause

vem primeiro

e:

é introduzida por:
