Para cada palestra, responda:

What is the main topic?

What are the main points?

What example is used?

What limitation is mentioned?

What is the final conclusion?

Finalize com uma regra essencial:

Ouça a estrutura, não apenas as palavras.

Em uma palestra B1, expressões como first, however, for example e to sum up funcionam como placas de sinalização: mostram onde você está no discurso e qual relação existe entre as informações. Quando você aprende a reconhecê-las, uma fala longa deixa de parecer uma sequência contínua de frases e passa a ter uma estrutura previsível e organizada.

Aula 93 — Writing B1: construção de parágrafos

Objetivos

Ao final desta aula, você deverá ser capaz de:

  • compreender a estrutura básica de um parágrafo em inglês;
  • identificar topic sentence, supporting sentences e concluding sentence;
  • desenvolver uma ideia principal de forma clara;
  • evitar parágrafos com ideias desconectadas;
  • usar exemplos, razões, explicações e consequências como apoio;
  • utilizar conectores para melhorar coesão;
  • manter unidade temática;
  • organizar informações em sequência lógica;
  • diferenciar frases gerais de detalhes específicos;
  • construir parágrafos descritivos, opinativos, explicativos e comparativos;
  • revisar parágrafos identificando problemas de organização;
  • evitar repetição excessiva;
  • utilizar referências pronominais e substituições lexicais;
  • produzir parágrafos adequados ao nível B1;
  • aplicar estratégias de planejamento, escrita e revisão em provas de proficiência.

Desenvolvimento

No nível B1, escrever bem não significa produzir frases extremamente complexas.

O mais importante é conseguir:

apresentar uma ideia

desenvolver essa ideia

conectar informações

finalizar o pensamento.

Um bom parágrafo é:

focused

organized

coherent

cohesive.

O que é um parágrafo?

Um parágrafo é um conjunto de frases que desenvolve:

uma ideia central.

Exemplo:

Online courses can be useful for people who have busy schedules. Students can usually study at different times and do not need to travel to a school or university every day. This flexibility is especially helpful for people who work full-time or live far from educational institutions. For these reasons, online learning can make education more accessible.

Todas as frases estão relacionadas a:

flexibility and accessibility of online courses.

Estrutura básica

Um parágrafo B1 bem organizado pode ser construído como:

Topic sentence

Supporting sentence 1

Supporting sentence 2

Example or explanation

Concluding sentence.

Essa estrutura não é obrigatória em todos os textos, mas é uma excelente base.

Topic sentence

A topic sentence apresenta:

a ideia principal do parágrafo.

Exemplo:

Regular exercise has several benefits for students.

Essa frase informa:

o assunto

e:

a direção do parágrafo.

Agora esperamos detalhes relacionados a:

benefits of exercise for students.

Supporting sentences

As frases de apoio:

explain

justify

exemplify

develop

a topic sentence.

Exemplo:

Regular exercise has several benefits for students. It can help reduce stress after long periods of study. Physical activity may also improve sleep quality, which is important for concentration. In addition, exercising with other people can provide opportunities for social interaction.

As últimas três frases são:

supporting sentences.

Concluding sentence

Uma frase final pode:

resumir

reforçar a ideia

mostrar consequência.

Exemplo:

For these reasons, regular physical activity can be an important part of a healthy student routine.

A conclusão não deve simplesmente:

copiar a topic sentence.

Ela pode reformular:

a mesma ideia central.

Estrutura visual

Podemos pensar:

Main idea

↓

Reason

↓

Example

↓

Additional support

↓

Conclusion

Unity

Unity significa:

unidade.

Todas as frases devem contribuir para:

a mesma ideia principal.

Considere:

Public transport can help reduce traffic in large cities. Buses can carry many passengers at the same time. Trains can also reduce the number of private cars on the road. My favorite type of music is jazz. Better public transport may therefore reduce congestion.

A frase:

My favorite type of music is jazz.

não pertence ao parágrafo.

Ela quebra:

unity.

Pergunta para verificar unidade

Para cada frase, pergunte:

Does this sentence support the main idea?

Se:

no

remova, altere ou coloque em outro parágrafo.

Coherence

Coherence é:

coerência.

As ideias precisam aparecer em uma ordem que faça sentido.

Exemplo ruim:

The course ended in June. First, students registered in January. They received their certificates. Then they attended classes for five months.

A ordem está confusa.

Melhor:

Students registered for the course in January. Then they attended classes for five months. The course ended in June, and successful students received their certificates.

Cohesion

Cohesion envolve:

mecanismos linguísticos que conectam as frases.

Exemplos:

however

therefore

in addition

this

these

it

they

such problems.

Coherence x cohesion

Um texto pode usar muitos conectores e ainda ser incoerente.

Exemplo:

I like coffee. Therefore, my university has a library. However, dogs are common pets.

Os conectores existem.

Mas:

as ideias não formam uma sequência lógica.

Logo:

cohesion alone is not enough.

Planejamento antes de escrever

Antes do parágrafo, responda:

What is my main idea?

What two or three points support it?

Do I have an example?

How will I finish?

Mini-outline

Tema:

Advantages of studying in a library.

Planejamento:

Main idea: library = good study environment

Reason 1: quiet

Reason 2: resources

Example: books/computers

Conclusion: useful for concentration and study.

Agora escrevemos.

Studying in a library can be more effective than studying in a noisy environment. Libraries usually provide quiet spaces where students can concentrate on their work. They also offer useful resources, such as books, computers and internet access. For example, a student who needs additional information for an assignment can often find it without leaving the library. Overall, libraries provide an organized environment that can support effective study.

Topic sentence muito ampla

Education is important.

É correta, mas muito geral.

Melhor:

Online education can make professional training more accessible to working adults.

Agora o parágrafo tem:

direção clara.

Topic sentence específica demais

My English class starts at 7:15 on Tuesday.

Isso pode ser detalhe, mas normalmente não sustenta facilmente:

um parágrafo argumentativo amplo.

Melhor:

Evening classes are useful for students who work during the day.

Controlar o tópico

Compare:

Technology is good.

Muito vago.

Digital tools can make communication between students and teachers faster.

Mais específico.

Desenvolvimento por razões

Uma forma simples:

statement + reasons.

Exemplo:

Learning English can create professional opportunities. Many international companies use English for communication between offices in different countries. In addition, employees who speak English may have access to a wider range of training materials and professional information. Therefore, improving English skills can be useful for career development.

Desenvolvimento por exemplo

Community gardens can improve urban neighborhoods. For example, unused land can be transformed into spaces where residents grow vegetables and meet other people. These gardens can also be used by schools for environmental education. As a result, a relatively small local project can provide social, educational and environmental benefits.

Desenvolvimento por causa e consequência

Lack of sleep can affect students’ academic performance. When students do not sleep enough, they may find it more difficult to concentrate during classes. Poor concentration can make learning and remembering new information harder. As a result, regular sleep is an important part of an effective study routine.

Desenvolvimento por comparação

Studying at home and studying in a library offer different advantages. At home, students may have greater comfort and flexibility. A library, however, usually provides a quieter and more structured environment. It may also offer resources that are not available at home. The best option therefore depends on the learner’s needs and study habits.

Desenvolvimento por problema e solução

Traffic congestion is a serious problem in many large cities. When too many people use private cars, journeys become slower and air pollution may increase. One possible solution is to improve public transport by providing more frequent and reliable services. If buses and trains become more convenient, some people may choose to leave their cars at home.

General statement + specific detail

Boa escrita normalmente se move entre:

general

e:

specific.

Exemplo:

Technology can support language learning.

Geral.

For example, learners can use online dictionaries, pronunciation tools and interactive exercises.

Específico.

Examples

Marcadores:

for example

for instance

such as.

Exemplo:

Students can develop practical skills through projects. For example, a programming student may build a simple application instead of only reading about software development.

Reasons

Marcadores:

because

since

one reason is

this is because.

Exemplo:

Public libraries remain important because they provide access to information and study spaces.

Addition

also

in addition

furthermore

moreover.

No B1, você não precisa usar:

moreover

em cada parágrafo.

Muitas vezes:

also

in addition

são suficientes.

Contrast

but

however

although

on the other hand.

Exemplo:

Working from home saves commuting time. However, some workers find it more difficult to separate work from personal life.

Result

so

therefore

as a result.

Exemplo:

The course had more applicants than expected. Therefore, the school opened an additional class.

Sequência

first

then

next

finally.

Particularmente útil para:

processes

narratives

instructions.

Não usar conectores artificialmente

Parágrafo ruim:

Firstly, technology is useful. Moreover, phones are common. Nevertheless, students use computers. Therefore, there are websites. Furthermore, education is important.

Há conectores.

Mas:

a lógica é fraca.

Conectores devem mostrar:

relações reais.

Repetição lexical

Compare:

The course is useful. The course is free. The course lasts six weeks. The course is online.

Gramaticalmente correto, mas repetitivo.

Melhor:

The course is useful and free. It lasts six weeks and is offered entirely online.

Pronominal reference

The university created a new program. It offers free evening classes.

it → program.

Demonstratives

The university reduced course fees. This change increased enrollment.

this change

cria:

coesão.

Sinônimos e expressões relacionadas

the course

the program

this training opportunity

podem, dependendo do contexto, evitar repetição.

Mas:

não use sinônimos apenas para parecer sofisticado.

A referência deve permanecer:

clara.

This/these + noun

Muito útil na escrita:

this problem

this change

this situation

these results

these measures

these advantages.

Exemplo:

More people are working remotely. This change has affected how companies use office space.

Frases muito curtas

Parágrafo:

Exercise is good. It reduces stress. It helps sleep. It is healthy. People should exercise.

Compreensível, mas pouco desenvolvido.

Melhor:

Regular exercise can contribute to a healthier lifestyle in several ways. It can reduce stress and may also help people sleep better. In addition, physical activity supports general physical health. For these reasons, including regular exercise in a weekly routine can be beneficial.

Frases excessivamente longas

Evite ligar tudo com:

and

and

and.

Exemplo ruim:

Online education is useful because students can study at home and they can work and study and they do not need to travel and this saves time and it is flexible.

Melhor:

Online education can be useful for people with busy schedules. Students can study from home, which reduces travel time. They may also organize their studies around work and other responsibilities. As a result, online courses can offer considerable flexibility.

Run-on sentence

Uma run-on sentence ocorre quando orações independentes são conectadas incorretamente.

Problemático:

The course was difficult I learned a lot.

Melhor:

The course was difficult, but I learned a lot.

Ou:

The course was difficult. However, I learned a lot.

Comma splice

Problemático:

The course was expensive, many students applied.

Duas orações completas foram conectadas apenas por:

vírgula.

Melhor:

The course was expensive, but many students applied.

Ou:

The course was expensive. However, many students applied.

Fragments

Um fragmento não possui estrutura suficiente para funcionar como frase completa.

Exemplo:

Because the course was expensive.

Isso sozinho está incompleto.

Precisamos:

Because the course was expensive, some students did not apply.

Outro fragmento

Although the results were promising.

Precisamos completar:

Although the results were promising, further research was needed.

Sentence variety

Não é necessário escrever estruturas muito complexas.

Mas variar ajuda.

Use:

simple sentence

compound sentence

complex sentence.

Simple sentence

The course starts in June.

Compound sentence

The course is intensive, but it is suitable for beginners.

Complex sentence

Although the course is intensive, it is suitable for beginners.

Combining sentences

Curto:

The city opened a new library. The library is near the station.

Com relative clause:

The city opened a new library that is located near the station.

Ou:

The city opened a new library near the station.

Relative clauses

Podem adicionar detalhes:

Students who work during the day may prefer evening classes.

The app, which was released last year, is now used by thousands of students.

Gerunds e infinitives

Studying regularly can improve performance.

The program was created to support adult learners.

Isso permite:

mais variedade gramatical.

Conditionals

If students receive regular feedback, they may improve more quickly.

Útil para:

consequências e possibilidades.

Modal verbs

Schools should provide…

Technology can help…

The program may improve…

Esses modais ajudam a:

controlar a força da afirmação.

Evite afirmações absolutas

Frase muito forte:

Online learning is always better than classroom learning.

Melhor:

Online learning can be more suitable for some students.

Ou:

Online learning offers several advantages, particularly for students who need greater flexibility.

Generalizations

Evite:

everyone

always

never

sem justificativa.

Prefira:

many people

some students

often

can

may.

Opinion paragraph

Estrutura simples:

opinion

reason 1

reason 2

example

conclusion.

Exemplo:

I believe public transport should receive more investment in large cities. Reliable buses and trains can reduce the number of private cars on the road, which may help decrease traffic congestion. Public transport can also make travel more affordable for people who do not own cars. For example, frequent bus services can connect residential areas with schools and workplaces. For these reasons, improving public transport can benefit both individuals and cities.

Frases para opinião

I think…

I believe…

In my opinion…

In my view…

No B1:

use com moderação.

Não é necessário iniciar cada frase com:

I think.

Descriptive paragraph

Objetivo:

descrever pessoa, lugar, experiência ou situação.

Exemplo:

The community library is a small but welcoming place in the center of the town. It has two main reading rooms, a computer area and a quiet study space on the second floor. Large windows make the rooms bright during the day, and the building is usually calm in the morning. Although it is not a large library, it provides an excellent place for students and local residents to study.

Narrative paragraph

Organização:

time sequence.

Exemplo:

Last Saturday, I attended a short technology workshop at a local training center. First, the instructor introduced the basic tools we would use. Then, we worked in small groups to complete a practical activity. At first, our group had difficulty understanding one part of the task, but the instructor gave us a useful example. By the end of the session, we had completed the activity successfully.

Explanatory paragraph

Recycling programs can reduce the amount of waste sent to landfill sites. When residents separate materials such as paper, glass and plastic, some of these resources can be processed and used again. As a result, less material is thrown away. However, recycling works best when people understand how to separate waste correctly. Clear public information is therefore an important part of an effective recycling program.

Compare-and-contrast paragraph

Online and face-to-face courses can both support learning, but they offer different experiences. Online courses usually provide greater flexibility because students can study from different locations. Face-to-face classes, on the other hand, allow more direct interaction with teachers and classmates. While some learners value flexibility, others prefer regular classroom contact. The most suitable format therefore depends on the student’s circumstances and preferences.

Paragraph length

Não existe um tamanho universal.

Em tarefas B1, um parágrafo pode ter aproximadamente:

70–120 words

dependendo da tarefa.

Um texto completo pode possuir:

vários parágrafos menores.

O importante é:

desenvolver adequadamente uma ideia.

Um parágrafo = uma ideia central

Se o texto fala de:

advantages

e depois:

disadvantages

pode ser melhor usar:

one paragraph for advantages

another for disadvantages.

Paragraph breaks

Exemplo:

P1

Introduction.

P2

Advantages.

P3

Disadvantages.

P4

Conclusion.

Isso facilita:

leitura

e:

organização.

Writing B1 e planejamento

Antes de escrever:

2–4 minutos de planejamento

podem evitar:

  • repetição;
  • falta de exemplo;
  • ideias desconectadas;
  • conclusão contraditória.

Método P-R-E

Uma estratégia simples:

Point

Reason

Example

Exemplo:

Point

Flexible work can improve work-life balance.

Reason

Employees can sometimes organize their schedules around personal responsibilities.

Example

For example, a parent may be able to start work earlier and finish before collecting a child from school.

Método P-E-E

Outra estrutura:

Point

Explanation

Example

Método PEEL

Mais completo:

Point

Evidence/Example

Explanation

Link

No B1, podemos adaptar:

P → main point

E → example

E → explanation

L → sentence linking back to the main idea.

Exemplo PEEL

Public libraries are important because they provide access to information for a wide range of people. For example, users can access books, computers and internet services without buying these resources themselves. This is particularly useful for students and low-income residents. Therefore, libraries can help make educational resources more accessible.

Editing

Depois de escrever, revise.

Pergunte:

Does every sentence support the topic?

Is the order logical?

Did I use connectors correctly?

Are pronouns clear?

Did I repeat the same word too often?

Are my verb tenses consistent?

Does the paragraph have a clear ending?

Revisão em camadas

Não tente verificar tudo ao mesmo tempo.

Primeira revisão

meaning and organization.

Segunda

grammar.

Terceira

spelling and punctuation.

Grammar checklist

Verifique:

subject-verb agreement.

verb tense.

articles.

plural forms.

prepositions.

pronouns.

connectors.

Third-person -s

Errado:

Technology help students.

Correto:

Technology helps students.

Singular/plural

Errado:

Many student prefer online courses.

Correto:

Many students prefer online courses.

Articles

a course

an example

the program

dependendo do contexto.

Prepositions

interested in

responsible for

access to

benefit from.

Punctuation

Use:

full stops

para evitar frases excessivamente longas.

Uma frase simples e correta:

é melhor

que uma frase longa e confusa.

Capitalization

Início de frase:

Online learning…

Nomes próprios:

London

Brazil

Central University.

O pronome:

I

sempre maiúsculo.

Spelling

Cuidado com famílias:

success

successful

successfully.

decide

decision.

improve

improvement.

Registro

Em escrita B1 formal ou semi-formal, evite excesso de:

gonna

wanna

stuff

things

quando houver palavra mais precisa.

Prefira:

going to

want to

materials/resources/issues

conforme contexto.

Things

Não é proibido.

Mas:

things are good

é vago.

Melhor:

online tools provide several benefits.

Very

Também não precisa ser eliminado.

Mas use vocabulário específico quando possível.

very bad problem

→

serious problem.

very important

→

essential / particularly important

quando apropriado.

Não force vocabulário difícil

Um parágrafo claro:

simples + correto

é melhor que:

complexo + artificial + incorreto.

Paragraph 1 — problema de unidade

Learning a language requires regular practice. Students can improve by reading, listening and using new vocabulary frequently. My brother bought a bicycle last week. Speaking practice is also important because learners need opportunities to produce language.

Problema:

bicycle sentence.

Versão revisada:

Learning a language requires regular practice. Students can improve by reading, listening and using new vocabulary frequently. Speaking practice is also important because learners need opportunities to produce language. For this reason, regular contact with the language can support progress.

Paragraph 2 — problema de desenvolvimento

Public transport is important. It is good. Many people use it. It is useful.

Problema:

ideas too general

no supporting detail.

Revisão:

Public transport is important because it allows large numbers of people to travel without using private cars. Reliable buses and trains can connect residential areas with workplaces, schools and services. In addition, greater use of public transport may help reduce traffic congestion. For these reasons, efficient transport systems are important for large cities.

Paragraph 3 — problema de lógica

Online courses are flexible. Therefore, some students find it difficult to remain motivated.

Problema:

therefore

indica consequência, mas a relação apresentada é:

contraste.

Melhor:

Online courses are flexible. However, some students find it difficult to remain motivated.

Paragraph 4 — repetição

The program helps students. The program gives students resources. The program also helps students study. The program is free for students.

Revisão:

The program provides students with free resources and additional study support. It also offers activities that help participants develop independent learning skills. Because there is no fee, the program is accessible to a wider range of students.

Paragraph 5 — opinião sem apoio

I think recycling is important. Recycling is very important. In my opinion, everyone should recycle because recycling is important.

Problema:

repetition

insufficient development.

Revisão:

Recycling can reduce the amount of waste sent to landfill sites and allow some materials to be used again. For example, paper, glass and certain plastics can be collected and processed instead of being thrown away. Although recycling is not a complete solution to environmental problems, it can form part of a broader strategy to reduce waste.

Vocabulário-chave

paragraph — parágrafo

topic sentence — frase que apresenta a ideia principal

supporting sentence — frase de apoio

concluding sentence — frase de conclusão

main idea — ideia principal

supporting detail — detalhe de apoio

unity — unidade temática

coherence — coerência

cohesion — coesão

outline — planejamento/esquema

example — exemplo

reason — razão

evidence — evidência

transition — transição

connector — conector

paragraph break — divisão de parágrafo

draft — rascunho

edit — revisar/editar

proofread — revisar especialmente erros de forma

Estratégia de prova

Em uma tarefa de Writing B1, não comece a escrever imediatamente.

Use um planejamento curto:

1. What exactly is the question asking?

2. What is my main answer?

3. What are my two or three supporting points?

4. What example can I give?

5. How will I conclude?

Para cada parágrafo:

one paragraph = one central idea.

Depois de escrever, faça o teste:

Can I summarize this paragraph in one sentence?

Se não consegue:

talvez existam ideias demais misturadas.

Outra estratégia:

circule mentalmente os conectores.

Pergunte:

Does “however” really show contrast?

Does “therefore” really show result?

Does “for example” really introduce an example?

Evite adicionar conectores apenas para:

parecer mais formal.

Prática

1. Identifique a topic sentence:

Regular reading can support vocabulary development. Readers encounter words in different contexts, which can help them understand meaning and usage. They may also see the same words several times in different texts. As a result, regular reading can contribute to long-term vocabulary learning.

  1. Readers encounter words in different contexts.
  2. Regular reading can support vocabulary development.
  3. They may see the same words several times.
  4. As a result…

2. Qual é supporting detail?

No texto anterior:

  1. Regular reading can support vocabulary development.
  2. Readers encounter words in different contexts.
  3. Vocabulary is impossible to learn.
  4. None.

3. Qual frase funciona como conclusão?

  1. Regular reading…
  2. Readers encounter…
  3. As a result, regular reading can contribute to long-term vocabulary learning.
  4. which can help…

4. Qual frase quebra a unidade?

Exercise can improve general health. It can strengthen the cardiovascular system and help people manage stress. My neighbor has a blue car. Regular activity may also improve sleep quality.

  1. primeira
  2. segunda
  3. terceira
  4. quarta

5. Escolha a melhor topic sentence para um parágrafo sobre benefícios de bibliotecas públicas:

  1. Libraries exist.
  2. Public libraries provide several important services to local communities.
  3. I saw a book yesterday.
  4. The library closes at six on Tuesdays.

6. Escolha o melhor supporting detail para a frase anterior:

  1. They provide free access to books, computers and study spaces.
  2. Libraries are buildings.
  3. My favorite color is green.
  4. Some buildings are tall.

7. Escolha a melhor conclusão:

Parágrafo sobre public libraries:

  1. For these reasons, public libraries can improve access to educational resources.
  2. Yesterday was Monday.
  3. Public libraries public libraries public libraries.
  4. I like pizza.

8. Organize em ordem lógica:

  1. As a result, students can review difficult content more easily.

  2. Recorded lessons are one advantage of some online courses.

  3. For example, learners can replay an explanation that they did not understand the first time.

Qual ordem é melhor?

9. Escolha o conector:

Working from home can save commuting time. ______, some employees find it difficult to separate work and personal life.

  1. Therefore
  2. However
  3. For example
  4. Because

10. Complete:

The university created more study spaces. ______, students had more places to work during the exam period.

  1. As a result
  2. Although
  3. For example
  4. Despite

11. Identifique o problema:

The course was difficult I learned a lot.

  1. fragment
  2. run-on sentence
  3. perfect sentence
  4. incorrect vocabulary only

12. Corrija a frase anterior de duas formas.

13. Identifique o problema:

Because the weather was bad.

  1. complete sentence
  2. fragment
  3. paragraph conclusion
  4. relative clause complete

14. Complete o fragmento de forma lógica.

15. Corrija:

Although the program was expensive, but many people applied.

16. Melhore a repetição:

The course is online. The course is free. The course lasts eight weeks.

17. Torne mais específica:

Technology is good.

Crie uma topic sentence adequada sobre:

technology in education.

18. Torne menos absoluta:

Online education is always better than classroom education.

19. Adicione um exemplo:

Regular physical activity can reduce stress.

Use:

for example.

20. Adicione uma consequência:

The university extended library opening hours.

Use:

as a result.

21. Leia o parágrafo:

Many adults return to education because they want to improve their career opportunities. Some enroll in courses to gain new qualifications, while others need additional skills for their current jobs. Flexible evening and online courses can make study easier for people who work full-time. For these reasons, adult education can play an important role in professional development.

Responda:

  1. What is the topic sentence?

  2. Give two supporting details.

  3. What is the concluding sentence?

22. Leia:

Public transport can reduce the number of cars in city centers. For example, frequent buses can encourage commuters to leave their cars at home. In addition, trains can carry large numbers of passengers efficiently. My first train journey was when I was seven years old. Better public transport may therefore help reduce traffic congestion.

Qual frase deve ser removida?

23. Identifique a estrutura:

The city has a serious waste problem. Many recyclable materials are still sent to landfill sites. One possible solution is to provide separate recycling containers in every neighborhood.

  1. comparison
  2. problem-solution
  3. narrative
  4. chronological biography

24. Identifique:

Online courses offer flexibility, whereas classroom courses provide more direct interaction.

  1. cause-effect
  2. comparison/contrast
  3. example
  4. sequence

25. Reescreva conectando as frases:

The project was expensive. The city decided to continue it.

Use:

although.

26. Reescreva:

The buses became more frequent. Passenger numbers increased.

Use:

as a result.

27. Desenvolva a topic sentence com duas supporting sentences:

Learning vocabulary in context can be more useful than memorizing isolated words.

28. Crie uma concluding sentence para:

Students can use the library for quiet study. They can also access computers and academic materials. Librarians can help them find reliable information.

29. Reorganize e revise o parágrafo:

Therefore, online courses can be useful for working adults. Many adults work during normal school hours. Online courses often allow students to study at different times. Education is important. This flexibility can make it easier to combine work and study.

Remova a frase que não contribui suficientemente e organize o restante.

30. Produção

Escreva um parágrafo de 130 a 160 palavras sobre:

One way technology can improve education

Inclua obrigatoriamente:

  • uma topic sentence clara;
  • pelo menos três supporting sentences;
  • um exemplo;
  • um conector de adição;
  • um conector de causa ou consequência;
  • um elemento de referência, como this, it, these tools ou this change;
  • uma concluding sentence.

Depois marque:

TS = Topic Sentence

SS = Supporting Sentence

EX = Example

CS = Concluding Sentence.

Gabarito comentado

1. B

Regular reading can support vocabulary development.

Essa frase apresenta:

a ideia central.

As outras:

desenvolvem essa ideia.

2. B

Readers encounter words in different contexts.

Isso é uma explicação de:

como a leitura pode ajudar o vocabulário.

3. C

A expressão:

As a result

introduz a síntese/consequência do parágrafo.

4. C

My neighbor has a blue car.

Não contribui para:

exercise and health.

Logo:

breaks unity.

5. B

É ampla o suficiente para permitir desenvolvimento, mas específica o bastante para:

definir o foco.

6. A

É um exemplo concreto de:

services offered by libraries.

7. A

Reformula a importância dos serviços apresentados.

8.

Ordem:

b → c → a

Primeiro:

general point.

Depois:

example.

Finalmente:

result.

Parágrafo:

Recorded lessons are one advantage of some online courses. For example, learners can replay an explanation that they did not understand the first time. As a result, students can review difficult content more easily.

9. B — However

Relação:

advantage x difficulty.

Logo:

contrast.

10. A — As a result

Mais espaços:

consequência → more places available.

11. B — run-on sentence

Temos duas orações completas sem conexão adequada:

The course was difficult

I learned a lot.

12.

Possibilidades:

The course was difficult, but I learned a lot.

Ou:

The course was difficult. However, I learned a lot.

13. B — fragment

Because the weather was bad…

introduz causa, mas falta:

main clause.

14.

Exemplo:

Because the weather was bad, the event was canceled.

15.

Although the program was expensive, many people applied.

Ou:

The program was expensive, but many people applied.

16.

The course is free, lasts eight weeks and is offered online.

Outra possibilidade:

The course is offered online. It is free and lasts eight weeks.

17.

Modelo:

Digital technology can give students faster access to educational resources.

Ou:

Digital tools can make classroom activities more interactive.

18.

Modelo:

Online education can be more suitable than classroom education for some students.

Ou:

Online education offers advantages for students who need greater flexibility.

19.

Modelo:

Regular physical activity can reduce stress. For example, taking a short walk after studying may help a student relax.

20.

Modelo:

The university extended library opening hours. As a result, students had more time to use study spaces in the evening.

21.

Many adults return to education because they want to improve their career opportunities.

Possíveis:

Some enroll to gain qualifications.

Others need skills for current jobs.

Flexible courses help full-time workers study.

For these reasons, adult education can play an important role in professional development.

22.

Remover:

My first train journey was when I was seven years old.

É uma experiência pessoal sem função clara no argumento sobre:

urban traffic.

23. B — problem-solution

Problem:

waste/recyclable material going to landfill.

Solution:

separate recycling containers.

24. B — comparison/contrast

whereas

contrasta:

online flexibility

com:

classroom interaction.

25.

Although the project was expensive, the city decided to continue it.

26.

The buses became more frequent. As a result, passenger numbers increased.

27.

Modelo:

Learning vocabulary in context can be more useful than memorizing isolated words. When learners see a word inside a sentence, they can understand how it is normally used. Context also helps students learn common combinations of words, which can make their own speaking and writing more natural.

28.

Modelo:

For these reasons, the library provides students with both a suitable study environment and useful academic support.

29.

Versão revisada:

Many adults work during normal school hours. Online courses often allow students to study at different times. This flexibility can make it easier to combine work and study. Therefore, online courses can be useful for working adults.

Removemos:

Education is important.

Não é falsa, mas é:

ampla demais

e não desenvolve diretamente a linha lógica específica.

Também reorganizamos:

situation → feature → consequence → conclusion.

30.

Modelo:

[TS] Digital learning platforms can improve education by giving students easier access to study materials. [SS] Learners can use these platforms to read texts, watch explanations and complete exercises outside normal classroom hours. [SS] In addition, teachers can upload extra activities for students who need more practice. [EX] For example, a learner who does not understand a grammar topic during class can watch an explanation again at home and complete an online quiz. [SS] This flexibility can support independent study because students have more opportunities to review difficult content at their own pace. [SS] Digital platforms may also provide immediate feedback on some activities, helping learners identify mistakes more quickly. [CS] For these reasons, when they are used appropriately, digital learning platforms can make educational resources more accessible and support students beyond the classroom.

Tarefa de consolidação

Crie dez topic sentences sobre os seguintes temas:

education

health

technology

public transport

work

environment

social media

libraries

exercise

language learning.

Para cada topic sentence, escreva:

Reason 1

Reason 2

Example

Conclusion

Depois transforme o planejamento em:

um parágrafo de 80 a 120 palavras.

Pratique também a identificação de problemas.

Para cinco parágrafos seus, verifique:

Unity — todas as frases estão no mesmo tópico?

Coherence — a ordem faz sentido?

Cohesion — as frases estão conectadas?

Development — existem detalhes suficientes?

Conclusion — o pensamento foi encerrado?

Use esta checklist:

□ Clear topic sentence

□ One central idea

□ At least two supporting points

□ Example or explanation

□ Appropriate connectors

□ Clear pronoun references

□ No unnecessary repetition

□ Correct verb tense

□ Correct subject-verb agreement

□ Appropriate punctuation

□ Concluding sentence when useful

Em seguida, pratique o método:

POINT → EXPLANATION → EXAMPLE → LINK

Exemplo:

Point: Public transport can reduce traffic.

Explanation: More passengers can travel without using private cars.

Example: A frequent bus service may encourage commuters to leave their cars at home.

Link: Therefore, better public transport can contribute to less congestion.

Finalize memorizando:

A paragraph is not simply a group of grammatically correct sentences.

Um bom parágrafo precisa apresentar:

one clear central idea + logically connected supporting information.

Antes de terminar qualquer parágrafo B1, pergunte:

Se o leitor só pudesse lembrar de uma ideia deste parágrafo, qual deveria ser?

Se essa resposta estiver clara, e todas as frases ajudarem a desenvolvê-la, a estrutura do parágrafo provavelmente está funcionando.

Aula 94 — Writing B1: opinião e comparação

Objetivos

Ao final desta aula, você deverá ser capaz de:

  • escrever parágrafos e textos curtos de opinião em inglês;
  • apresentar uma opinião de forma clara e adequada ao nível B1;
  • justificar opiniões com razões e exemplos;
  • comparar duas opções, situações ou ideias;
  • apresentar semelhanças e diferenças;
  • utilizar conectores de contraste e comparação;
  • diferenciar opinion, reason, example e conclusion;
  • escrever textos equilibrados, evitando afirmações absolutas sem apoio;
  • empregar estruturas comparativas e superlativas;
  • usar expressões como I think, in my opinion, while, whereas, however e on the other hand;
  • organizar um texto com introdução, desenvolvimento e conclusão;
  • desenvolver argumentos simples de forma coerente;
  • evitar repetição excessiva;
  • utilizar linguagem adequada para comparar vantagens e desvantagens;
  • revisar textos de opinião e comparação em tarefas de proficiência B1.

Desenvolvimento

No nível B1, tarefas de Writing frequentemente pedem que você:

give your opinion

compare two options

discuss advantages and disadvantages

explain which option you prefer

give reasons for your answer.

Exemplos de enunciados:

Do you think students should use technology in the classroom?

Is it better to study alone or in a group?

Compare living in a large city with living in a small town.

What are the advantages and disadvantages of working from home?

O objetivo não é produzir uma análise extremamente complexa.

Você precisa demonstrar que consegue:

state a position

explain it

support it

organize it.

Opinion

Opinion significa:

opinião.

Uma opinião expressa:

what you think

what you believe

what you prefer.

Expressões básicas de opinião

I think…

I believe…

In my opinion,…

In my view,…

From my point of view,…

No B1, as três primeiras são mais do que suficientes.

I think

I think public transport should be cheaper.

I believe

I believe schools should provide more opportunities for practical learning.

In my opinion

In my opinion, online courses are useful for students who need flexible schedules.

Evite repetir I think

Texto fraco:

I think online learning is useful. I think it is flexible. I think students save time. I think it is good.

Melhor:

I think online learning is useful because it offers greater flexibility. Students can organize their study around work and other responsibilities. In addition, they may save time because they do not need to travel to a classroom every day.

Opinion + reason

Uma opinião sem justificativa costuma ser pouco desenvolvida.

I think public libraries are important.

Isso é apenas:

opinion.

Melhor:

I think public libraries are important because they provide free access to books, computers and study spaces.

Agora temos:

opinion + reason.

Opinion + reason + example

I think public libraries are important because they provide free access to educational resources. For example, students who do not have internet access at home can often use library computers to complete assignments.

Estrutura:

opinion

reason

example.

Conclusion

Podemos fechar:

For these reasons, public libraries continue to play an important role in local communities.

Agora temos:

opinion → reason → example → conclusion.

Estrutura simples para opinião

Uma estrutura B1 eficaz:

Position

Reason 1

Example

Reason 2

Conclusion

Exemplo completo

In my opinion, schools should encourage students to read regularly. Reading can help learners develop vocabulary and become more familiar with different sentence structures. For example, students who read short articles in English may encounter the same words in several contexts. Reading can also improve general knowledge and expose learners to different ideas. For these reasons, regular reading can be a useful part of language education.

Dar razões

Expressões úteis:

because

since

one reason is that…

another reason is that…

this is because…

One reason is that

One reason is that public transport can reduce the number of cars on the road.

Another reason

Another reason is that buses and trains can be more affordable than using a private car every day.

Exemplificação

for example

for instance

such as.

Exemplo:

Technology can support independent learning. For example, students can use online dictionaries and pronunciation tools outside the classroom.

Consequência

therefore

as a result

so.

Exemplo:

Online courses do not require daily travel. As a result, they may save students time.

Opinion language com intensidade controlada

Compare:

Online education is the best form of education for everyone.

Muito absoluto.

Melhor:

Online education can be a good option for students who need greater flexibility.

Ou:

I believe online education is particularly useful for some adult learners.

Hedging

Hedging significa reduzir a força de uma afirmação.

Palavras úteis:

may

might

can

often

generally

in many cases

for some people.

Exemplo

Forte demais:

Social media causes stress.

Mais cuidadoso:

Social media can contribute to stress for some users.

Another example

Working from home is better.

Melhor:

Working from home can be more convenient for people who have long commutes.

Comparação

Outra tarefa comum é comparar:

two things

two situations

two choices.

Exemplos:

online learning vs classroom learning

city life vs country life

public transport vs private cars

working from home vs working in an office.

Similarity

Para semelhanças:

both

similarly

in the same way

also.

Both

Both online and face-to-face courses can help students develop new skills.

Estrutura:

both X and Y.

Also

Classroom learning provides access to teachers. Online learning also allows students to communicate with instructors.

Similarly

Public libraries provide access to information. Similarly, digital libraries can make educational materials available to large numbers of people.

Differences

Para diferenças:

but

however

while

whereas

unlike

on the other hand

in contrast.

But

Online courses are flexible, but classroom courses provide more direct interaction.

However

Online courses are flexible. However, some students prefer face-to-face communication.

While

While online learning offers flexibility, classroom learning offers more direct interaction.

Whereas

Online courses can be accessed from different locations, whereas classroom courses require students to attend a specific place.

Unlike

Unlike traditional classroom courses, online courses do not always require students to travel.

On the other hand

Living in a large city provides access to many services. On the other hand, smaller towns are often quieter.

Comparatives

Comparativos são fundamentais.

cheaper than

more flexible than

easier than

faster than

more convenient than

less expensive than.

Short adjectives

small → smaller than

fast → faster than

cheap → cheaper than

easy → easier than.

Long adjectives

convenient → more convenient than

flexible → more flexible than

expensive → more expensive than

difficult → more difficult than.

Less

less expensive than

less stressful than

less convenient than.

As…as

Para igualdade:

as useful as

as expensive as

as difficult as.

Exemplo:

Online courses can be as challenging as classroom courses.

Not as…as

A bicycle is not as fast as a car.

Superlatives

Às vezes o texto pede escolher:

the best option.

Estruturas:

the best

the most useful

the most convenient

the least expensive.

Mas cuidado:

superlativos podem criar afirmações fortes.

Use quando:

a tarefa realmente exige escolha.

Preference

Expressões:

I prefer X to Y.

I would prefer X because…

I would rather…

For me, X is more suitable because…

Prefer X to Y

I prefer studying in a library to studying at home.

Não:

prefer X than Y.

Would rather

I would rather study at home because it is more convenient.

Estrutura:

would rather + base verb.

Would prefer

I would prefer to take an online course because I work during the day.

Comparing advantages

Uma estrutura simples:

X offers advantage A.

Y offers advantage B.

Therefore, choice depends on…

Exemplo:

Online courses offer greater flexibility because students can study from different locations. Face-to-face courses, however, provide more direct interaction with teachers and classmates. Therefore, the better option depends on the learner’s schedule and preferred way of studying.

Balanced comparison

Um bom texto comparativo não precisa:

atacar uma opção

para defender:

outra.

Você pode reconhecer:

strengths of both.

Exemplo:

Both buses and private cars can be useful forms of transport. Cars offer greater privacy and flexibility, whereas buses can be cheaper and reduce the number of vehicles on the road. For people who live in areas with reliable public transport, buses may be the more practical option.

Opinion within comparison

Tarefa:

Which is better: studying alone or studying in a group?

Estrutura possível:

Paragraph 1

Introduce both options.

Paragraph 2

Advantages of studying alone.

Paragraph 3

Advantages of group study + comparison.

Paragraph 4

Your preference/conclusion.

Introdução

Studying alone and studying in a group can both be effective, but they offer different advantages.

Boa introdução porque:

apresenta ambos

sem:

desenvolver tudo ainda.

Desenvolvimento 1

Studying alone gives learners greater control over their schedule and pace. They can spend more time on difficult topics without waiting for other people.

Desenvolvimento 2

Group study, on the other hand, allows students to exchange ideas and explain concepts to one another. This can be especially useful when preparing for discussion-based tasks.

Conclusão

In my view, studying alone is more suitable for focused revision, although group study can be useful for discussing difficult topics.

Opinion essay B1

Uma estrutura simples para texto curto:

Introduction

Reason 1

Reason 2

Conclusion

Introdução direta

Tema:

Should schools use more technology?

Introdução:

Technology has become common in education, and I believe schools can benefit from using digital tools when they are used appropriately.

Razão 1

One advantage is that technology gives students access to a wider range of educational materials.

Exemplo

For example, teachers can use videos, interactive exercises and online dictionaries to support classroom activities.

Razão 2

Technology can also help students continue studying outside normal class hours.

Limitação

However, digital tools should not completely replace teacher interaction or traditional learning activities.

Conclusão

Overall, I believe technology can improve education when it is used as one part of a balanced learning environment.

Advantages and disadvantages

Tarefas podem pedir:

advantages and disadvantages.

Não são exatamente iguais a:

opinion only.

Você precisa discutir:

both sides.

Estrutura

Introduction

Advantages

Disadvantages

Conclusion/opinion.

Exemplo

Tema:

working from home.

Working from home has become common in many professions. It offers several advantages, but it can also create challenges.

Advantage:

One important benefit is that employees can save commuting time.

Additional advantage:

In addition, some workers have more flexibility to organize their day.

Disadvantage:

However, working from home can make communication with colleagues more difficult.

Another:

Some people may also find it harder to separate work from personal life.

Conclusion:

Overall, remote work can be useful, but its effectiveness depends on the employee’s situation and the type of job.

Compare x discuss advantages/disadvantages

Compare

X versus Y.

Advantages/disadvantages

positive and negative aspects of one topic.

Às vezes a tarefa combina:

compare two options and give your opinion.

Leia o comando com cuidado.

Command words

compare

→ show similarities/differences.

discuss

→ examine aspects.

explain

→ give reasons/details.

give your opinion

→ state what you think.

describe

→ give characteristics.

choose

→ select an option and justify.

Responder a todas as partes

Prompt:

Compare online and face-to-face courses and say which you prefer.

Se você apenas:

compare

mas não diz:

which you prefer,

a resposta está incompleta.

Planning

Antes de escrever uma comparação, faça:

Online Face-to-face
flexible direct interaction
no travel fixed location
requires technology classroom structure

Depois escolha:

what matters for your answer.

Não precisa usar:

todos os pontos.

Block organization

Método 1:

paragraph about A

paragraph about B.

Exemplo:

P2 = online

P3 = face-to-face.

Point-by-point organization

Método 2:

Compare por critério.

flexibility: online vs classroom

interaction: online vs classroom

cost: online vs classroom.

No B1, ambos funcionam.

Point-by-point example

Online courses are generally more flexible because students can study from different locations. Classroom courses, however, require attendance at a specific time and place. In terms of interaction, face-to-face courses usually provide more immediate communication, while online communication may depend on video calls or messages.

In terms of

Expressão útil:

in terms of cost

in terms of flexibility

in terms of convenience.

Exemplo:

In terms of flexibility, online learning often has an advantage.

When it comes to

Mais conversacional:

When it comes to interaction, classroom learning may be more suitable.

Compared with

Compared with private cars, buses can transport more passengers using less road space.

Compared to

Também amplamente usado:

Compared to studying alone, group study provides more opportunities for discussion.

By comparison

The first course costs $500. By comparison, the second costs only $250.

Similarly

Both courses include weekly assignments. Similarly, both require a final project.

In contrast

The first program is fully online. In contrast, the second requires daily attendance.

On the one hand / on the other hand

Estrutura clássica:

On the one hand, living in a city provides access to more services. On the other hand, city life can be expensive and stressful.

Use com moderação.

One advantage / one disadvantage

One advantage of working from home is flexibility.

One disadvantage is reduced face-to-face interaction.

The main advantage

The main advantage of public transport is that it can carry many passengers efficiently.

A major drawback

A major drawback of living far from work is the long commute.

Drawback

desvantagem.

Benefit

benefício.

Positive aspect

aspecto positivo.

Negative aspect

aspecto negativo.

Opinion stronger or softer

Mais direto:

I strongly believe…

Mais neutro:

I believe…

Mais cauteloso:

I tend to think…

No B1, prefira:

clareza.

Avoid emotional exaggeration

Fraco:

Online classes are absolutely terrible and classroom classes are perfect.

Melhor:

Online classes can be difficult for students who need regular face-to-face support, whereas classroom learning provides more direct contact with teachers.

Give specific reasons

Fraco:

I prefer cities because cities are better.

Melhor:

I prefer living in a city because public transport, healthcare and educational services are usually easier to access.

Avoid circular reasoning

Public transport is better because it is better for people.

Não desenvolve.

Melhor:

Public transport can be more affordable because passengers do not need to pay for fuel, parking and vehicle maintenance.

Examples make arguments clearer

Working from home can save time. For example, an employee who normally spends an hour commuting each way may save several hours every week.

Personal examples

Podem ser usados se a tarefa permitir.

For example, when I study at home, I can organize my breaks more easily.

Mas não transforme todo o texto em:

autobiografia

se o prompt pede:

discussão geral.

General examples

Frequentemente mais seguros:

For example, a student who works full-time may prefer an online course.

One-sentence paragraphs

Evite em textos curtos de proficiência quando:

a ideia ainda precisa ser desenvolvida.

Parágrafo:

Online learning is flexible.

Muito curto.

Desenvolva:

Online learning is flexible because students can often choose when and where they study. This can be particularly useful for people who work or have family responsibilities.

Topic sentence em comparação

Living in cities and living in small towns offer very different lifestyles.

Depois:

contrast details.

Topic sentence para opinião

I believe public transport should receive more investment in large cities.

Depois:

reasons.

Concluding paragraph

A conclusão deve:

  • responder ao prompt;
  • resumir posição;
  • não introduzir argumento completamente novo.

Frase útil

In conclusion, both options have advantages, but I would prefer…

Overall

Overall, online education offers greater flexibility, whereas classroom learning provides more direct interaction.

All things considered

Mais avançado, mas útil:

All things considered, public transport is the more practical option for people who live in well-connected urban areas.

Don’t introduce new evidence in conclusion

Ruim:

In conclusion, I prefer buses. Also, a new scientific study found that trains reduce stress by 37%.

Essa nova evidência deveria aparecer:

no desenvolvimento.

Coesão

Evite repetir:

online courses

em toda frase.

Use:

they

this format

this type of learning

quando a referência estiver clara.

Exemplo

Online courses offer flexibility. They can also reduce travel time. This format is particularly useful for students who live far from educational institutions.

Comparative reference

The first option

the second option

the former

the latter.

No B1, first/second option costuma ser mais claro.

Former/latter

Online and classroom learning have different advantages. The former is more flexible, while the latter offers more direct interaction.

Correto, mas:

use apenas se estiver seguro.

Common error: more easier

Errado:

more easier.

Correto:

easier.

Common error: more cheaper

Errado:

more cheaper.

Correto:

cheaper.

Common error: prefer than

Errado:

I prefer online courses than classroom courses.

Correto:

I prefer online courses to classroom courses.

Common error: than after similar

Errado:

Online learning is similar than classroom learning.

Correto:

Online learning is similar to classroom learning.

Different from

Online learning is different from classroom learning.

Same as

The price is the same as last year.

Similar to

The two programs are similar to each other.

Better than

This option is better than the other one for students who need flexibility.

More suitable for

Uma expressão menos absoluta:

Online learning may be more suitable for working adults.

Muito útil para B1.

Advantages of both

Both methods can be effective when students receive appropriate support.

Isso demonstra:

balanced comparison.

Grammar integration — conditionals

If students have reliable internet access, online learning can be convenient.

Modal verbs

Classroom interaction may help some students remain motivated.

Relative clauses

Students who work during the day may prefer evening or online courses.

Present Perfect

Passive Voice

Gerunds

Infinitives

Writing prompt 1

Is it better to study alone or with other people?

Planejamento:

Alone

own pace

fewer distractions

control schedule.

Group

exchange ideas

help each other

discussion.

Opinion:

alone for focused revision, groups for discussion.

Modelo

Studying alone and studying with other people can both be effective, but they offer different benefits. Studying alone allows learners to work at their own pace and focus on the topics they personally find difficult. It can also reduce distractions if the student has a quiet place to work. Group study, on the other hand, provides opportunities to exchange ideas and explain concepts to other people. For example, students may understand a difficult topic better after discussing it with classmates. In my view, studying alone is more useful for focused revision because I can organize my time more easily. However, group study can be particularly valuable when a task requires discussion or collaboration. Therefore, the best method may depend on the type of activity.

Writing prompt 2

Compare travelling by public transport and by private car.

Modelo:

Public transport and private cars offer different advantages. A private car usually provides greater flexibility because drivers can choose their route and departure time. However, owning and using a car can be expensive because of fuel, maintenance and parking costs. Public transport, by comparison, can be more affordable and allows many passengers to travel using fewer vehicles. In addition, buses and trains may help reduce traffic if enough people use them. On the other hand, public transport can be inconvenient in areas where services are infrequent. In my view, public transport is more practical in cities with reliable transport networks, whereas a private car may be more useful in areas with limited services.

Writing prompt 3

Do social media platforms have more advantages or disadvantages?

Modelo:

Social media platforms have both advantages and disadvantages. One important benefit is that they allow people to communicate quickly with friends, relatives and professional contacts. They can also provide access to news, educational content and online communities. However, excessive use may reduce the time people spend on other activities, and unreliable information can spread rapidly online. In addition, some users may experience stress when they compare themselves constantly with other people. In my opinion, social media can be useful when it is used carefully and responsibly. The platforms themselves offer valuable communication tools, but users need to manage their time and evaluate online information critically.

Writing prompt 4

Is living in a city better than living in a small town?

Modelo:

Large cities and small towns offer very different lifestyles. Cities generally provide easier access to jobs, universities, hospitals and entertainment. Public transport may also be more widely available. Small towns, however, are often quieter and may have less traffic. Housing can also be more affordable in some smaller communities. On the other hand, residents may need to travel farther to access specialized services or certain job opportunities. In my view, neither option is better for everyone. City life may be more suitable for people who value access to services and professional opportunities, whereas a small town may be preferable for those who want a quieter environment.

Writing prompt 5

Should students use artificial intelligence tools for learning?

Estrutura possível:

position: useful if used responsibly

benefit 1: explanations/support

benefit 2: practice/feedback

risk: dependence / incorrect information

conclusion: tool, not replacement for learning.

Modelo:

I believe artificial intelligence tools can support learning when students use them responsibly. These tools can provide explanations, generate practice questions and help learners review difficult topics. For example, a student can ask for additional examples after a grammar lesson. However, AI-generated information may sometimes be inaccurate, and students may learn less if they simply copy answers without thinking about them. Teachers therefore need to help students understand how to check information and use these tools appropriately. In my view, artificial intelligence should be used as a learning resource rather than as a replacement for studying, practicing and developing independent skills.

in my view — na minha visão

overall — no geral

Estratégia de prova

Ao receber uma tarefa de opinião ou comparação, sublinhe mentalmente os verbos do comando.

Exemplo:

Compare online and classroom learning and say which you prefer.

Há duas tarefas:

compare

e:

give preference.

Se você fizer apenas uma:

Planeje em quatro passos:

1. Position

O que você realmente acha?

2. Two main reasons

Quais dois motivos sustentam isso?

3. Example

Que exemplo pode deixar o argumento claro?

4. Other side

Existe um ponto válido do outro lado?

Isso ajuda a produzir texto:

balanced and developed.

Antes de entregar, verifique:

Did I answer every part of the task?

Did I explain why?

Did I compare instead of only describing?

Did I use examples?

Is my conclusion consistent with my introduction?

Both printed books and e-books can provide access to the same information. E-books are easy to carry and store. However, printed books do not require a battery or electronic device.

29.

Modelo:

I think online learning can be a good option for students who need greater flexibility. Learners can often study from home and organize lessons around work or other responsibilities. However, classroom learning also has important advantages because students can communicate with teachers and classmates more directly. For this reason, I would not say that online learning is better for everyone. It may be more suitable for independent learners, while other students may benefit more from regular classroom interaction.

O texto revisado:

reduz repetição;

evita “better for everyone”;

reconhece a outra opção;

explica a preferência.

30.

Modelo:

Online learning and traditional classroom learning can both provide effective education, but they offer different experiences. Both formats can include lessons, assignments and communication with teachers. However, online education is generally more flexible because students can often study from different locations and organize their work around other responsibilities. For example, a person who works full-time may find it easier to attend an online course in the evening.

Traditional classrooms, on the other hand, provide more direct face-to-face interaction. Students can ask questions immediately and communicate naturally with classmates, whereas online communication may depend on messages or video calls. Classroom learning can therefore be more suitable for people who need regular structure and direct support.

In my opinion, online learning is the better option for students who are independent and need flexible schedules. I would prefer it because it can reduce travel time and make study easier to combine with work. However, traditional classes remain valuable for learners who prefer direct interaction.

In conclusion, neither format is ideal for everyone, and the best choice depends on the learner’s needs.

Tarefa de consolidação

Escolha cinco pares para comparação:

online learning × classroom learning

city × small town

public transport × private car

printed books × e-books

working from home × office work.

Para cada par, crie uma tabela:

Critério Opção A Opção B
cost
flexibility
convenience
interaction
advantages
disadvantages

Nem todo critério servirá para todos os temas. Use apenas os relevantes.

Depois escreva:

uma frase com both;

uma com whereas;

uma com however;

uma com comparative;

uma frase de preferência.

Exemplo:

Both online and classroom courses can develop academic skills.

Online courses offer flexibility, whereas classroom courses provide more direct interaction.

Online study is convenient. However, it requires good time management.

Online learning can be more flexible than classroom learning.

I prefer online learning to classroom learning because it fits my schedule better.

Em seguida, crie cinco parágrafos de opinião usando:

Opinion

Reason

Example

Additional reason

Conclusion.

Treine substituir afirmações absolutas:

always

never

everyone

completely

por linguagem mais apropriada quando necessário:

often

sometimes

many people

some students

may

can

in many cases.

Revise também:

prefer X to Y

better than

more/less + adjective + than

as + adjective + as

similar to

different from

both X and Y

unlike X, Y…

Finalize qualquer texto de opinião ou comparação perguntando:

Did I clearly answer the question?

Did I explain my reasons?

Did I support them with examples?

Did I represent the other option fairly?

Did I avoid claims stronger than my arguments support?

Em Writing B1, uma opinião não se torna melhor por parecer mais forte. Ela se torna melhor quando está clara, organizada e adequadamente justificada.

Aula 95 — Writing B1: resumos básicos

Objetivos

Ao final desta aula, você deverá ser capaz de:

  • compreender o que é um summary;
  • distinguir resumo de cópia, comentário e opinião;
  • identificar a ideia principal de um texto;
  • selecionar informações essenciais;
  • eliminar exemplos, repetições e detalhes secundários;
  • reorganizar informações de forma clara e concisa;
  • escrever um resumo usando suas próprias palavras;
  • usar paráfrases simples;
  • manter o sentido original do texto;
  • evitar acrescentar informações que não aparecem na fonte;
  • reconhecer quando um detalhe é necessário para preservar a ideia;
  • usar conectores básicos em resumos;
  • reduzir textos mantendo coerência;
  • produzir resumos curtos de textos informativos, jornalísticos e científicos;
  • revisar um resumo quanto a fidelidade, concisão e organização.

Desenvolvimento

Um summary é:

a shorter version of a text that presents its most important ideas.

Em português:

resumo.

O objetivo não é:

copiar o texto

nem:

comentar o texto.

O objetivo é:

representar a mensagem principal de forma mais curta.

Exemplo simples

Texto original:

A local university has introduced free evening computer classes for adults. The program was created for people who work during the day and cannot attend regular daytime courses. Classes include basic computer skills, internet safety and office software. More than 300 people applied during the first week.

Resumo:

A local university has launched free evening computer classes for working adults, covering basic digital skills and attracting strong initial interest.

O resumo mantém:

  • quem;
  • o que aconteceu;
  • público;
  • conteúdo geral;
  • importância inicial.

Mas elimina:

detalhes menos essenciais.

Summary x copy

Copiar:

A local university has introduced free evening computer classes for adults.

Isso é:

reprodução.

Não necessariamente:

resumo.

Summary x opinion

Texto:

The city introduced a new recycling system.

Comentário:

I think this is an excellent idea.

Isso não é resumo.

É:

opinion.

Summary x analysis

The author uses statistics to persuade readers.

Isso é:

analysis.

Não:

summary.

Regra central

Um resumo responde:

What does the source say?

Não:

What do I think about it?

Identificação da ideia principal

Antes de resumir, identifique:

main idea.

Pergunte:

What is the text mainly about?

What is the central message?

What happened?

What did the writer conclude?

Sem isso, é fácil selecionar:

detalhes errados.

Exemplo

Texto:

Many universities are extending library opening hours during examination periods. Some now remain open until midnight, while others provide twenty-four-hour study areas. Students say the extended schedules help them study around classes and work commitments. However, universities must also consider staffing and security costs.

Ideia principal:

Universities are extending library hours to support students, although this creates practical costs.

Não:

Some libraries stay open until midnight.

Isso é apenas:

detail.

Informação essencial

Geralmente inclui:

  • main idea;
  • main event;
  • main cause;
  • main result;
  • major conclusion;
  • important contrast.

Informação frequentemente removida

Pode incluir:

  • exemplos detalhados;
  • repetições;
  • ilustrações;
  • nomes pouco importantes;
  • estatísticas secundárias;
  • explicações redundantes.

Mas cuidado

Não remova um detalhe se ele for:

essential to the main meaning.

Exemplo:

The treatment improved symptoms, but only temporarily.

Se você resumir:

The treatment improved symptoms.

Você perdeu:

uma limitação essencial.

Melhor:

The treatment temporarily improved symptoms.

Contrast matters

Palavras como:

but

however

although

podem introduzir informações importantes.

Texto:

The project reduced costs. However, it also increased waiting times.

Resumo inadequado:

The project reduced costs.

Resumo melhor:

The project reduced costs but increased waiting times.

Cause matters

Texto:

The event was canceled because of heavy rain.

Resumo:

Heavy rain caused the event to be canceled.

A causa é:

central.

Result matters

The company introduced flexible working hours, which led to higher employee satisfaction.

Resumo:

Flexible working hours increased employee satisfaction.

Summary length

Não existe um tamanho único.

Um resumo deve ser:

substantially shorter than the source.

Se o texto tem:

300 words,

um resumo pode ter, dependendo da tarefa:

60–100 words.

Mas sempre siga:

o limite solicitado.

Word limit

Em provas:

respeite rigorosamente.

Se pede:

80–100 words

não escreva:

First reading

Na primeira leitura:

compreenda o texto geral.

Não escreva o resumo ainda.

Second reading

Na segunda:

identifique main ideas.

Marque mentalmente:

P1 → topic/problem

P2 → evidence

P3 → result

P4 → conclusion.

Paragraph mapping

Exemplo:

P1

city traffic problem.

P2

new bus routes introduced.

P3

passenger numbers increased.

P4

program may expand.

Resumo:

A city introduced new bus routes to address traffic problems. Passenger use increased after the changes, and officials are now considering expanding the program.

Não resumir frase por frase

Erro comum:

Pegar cada frase e reduzi-la.

Isso pode produzir:

mini-texto longo e fragmentado.

Melhor:

agrupar ideias.

Combining ideas

Original:

The course is free. It is offered online. It lasts eight weeks.

Resumo:

The university offers a free eight-week online course.

Três frases viraram:

uma.

Paraphrasing

Paraphrase significa expressar:

a mesma ideia com palavras diferentes.

Exemplo:

The company reduced the number of employees.

Paráfrase:

The company cut its workforce.

No B1, não precisa usar palavras muito sofisticadas.

Simple paraphrase

Original:

Many people prefer online shopping because it is convenient.

Paráfrase:

Online shopping is popular because many consumers find it convenient.

Mudança de estrutura

Original:

Because the weather was bad, the event was canceled.

Paráfrase:

Bad weather caused the cancellation of the event.

Active x passive

Original:

Researchers collected 500 samples.

Paráfrase:

Five hundred samples were collected by the research team.

Mas não use Passive Voice apenas para:

parecer mais formal.

Word family

Original:

Prices increased rapidly.

Paráfrase:

There was a rapid increase in prices.

Synonyms

buy → purchase

help → support

start → begin

reduce → decrease

approximately → about

important → significant

quando o contexto permitir.

Não trocar por sinônimo inadequado

Exemplo:

students

não é necessariamente:

children.

job

não é sempre:

career.

Paráfrase deve preservar:

meaning.

Summary verbs

Úteis:

explains

describes

reports

shows

suggests

discusses

presents.

Exemplo:

The article describes how a city is improving public transport.

Mas nem todo resumo precisa começar:

The text says…

Às vezes é mais direto começar pela informação.

Reporting the source

Podemos escrever:

The article reports that…

The study suggests that…

The report explains how…

Isso é útil especialmente quando:

a fonte da informação importa.

Scientific summaries

Em textos científicos, preserve:

caution.

Original:

The results suggest that regular walking may improve sleep.

Resumo errado:

Walking improves sleep.

Resumo correto:

The study suggests that regular walking may improve sleep.

Não transforme:

possibility

em:

certainty.

Association x causation

Original:

Higher screen use was associated with poorer sleep.

Resumo errado:

Screen use caused poor sleep.

Resumo correto:

The study found an association between higher screen use and poorer sleep.

Quantifiers

Preserve:

some

many

most

all.

Original:

Most participants preferred the new system.

Resumo errado:

All participants preferred it.

Approximation

Original:

Approximately 500 people attended.

Resumo:

About 500 people attended.

Não:

Exactly 500.

Important numbers

Nem todo número deve entrar.

Texto:

The program began in April. It serves 1,500 residents and includes six weekly activities.

Se o foco é:

scale of the program

1,500 pode ser importante.

Se o foco é:

tipo de atividade,

talvez não.

Names

Pergunte:

Is this name necessary to understand the main point?

Texto:

Professor Helen Morris led a university study on sleep.

Resumo possível:

University researchers conducted a study on sleep.

O nome pode ser removido.

Dates

Se a data não muda a compreensão principal:

pode ser omitida.

Original:

The program began on March 12, 2025.

Resumo:

The program began last year.

Ou simplesmente:

The program was introduced.

Mas, em tarefas onde cronologia é central:

mantenha a data.

Examples

Original:

Renewable energy sources such as solar, wind and hydroelectric power are becoming more important.

Resumo:

Renewable energy sources are becoming more important.

Os exemplos podem ser removidos.

Example necessary?

Se o texto explica um termo novo com exemplo:

talvez o exemplo seja útil.

Tudo depende:

da função no texto.

Repetition

Textos podem repetir uma ideia para:

emphasis.

Resumo deve normalmente:

apresentar uma vez.

Redundancy

Original:

The program was successful. It achieved positive results and met its main goals.

Resumo:

The program successfully met its main goals.

Personal reaction

Não inclua:

I liked the article.

I agree.

This is interesting.

a menos que a tarefa peça:

opinião.

Evaluation

Também evite:

The author gives a very good argument.

Isso é avaliação.

Neutral style

Resumo normalmente usa:

neutral language.

Tense

O tempo verbal depende da fonte.

Notícia recente:

The city has introduced…

Resumo:

The city has introduced…

Evento passado:

Researchers conducted…

Resumo:

Researchers conducted…

Present para conteúdo de texto

Também é comum:

The article explains…

The report discusses…

Consistency

Não alterne sem motivo:

present → past → present.

Pronouns

Garanta referência clara.

Fraco:

The city launched a program. They said it was useful.

Quem é:

they?

Melhor:

City officials said the program was useful.

Cohesion

Use conectores apenas quando necessários:

but

because

while

however

as a result.

Combining contrast

Original:

Online courses are flexible. Some students find them isolating.

Resumo:

Online courses are flexible but can feel isolating for some students.

Combining cause-effect

Original:

The city reduced bus fares. Passenger numbers increased.

Resumo:

Passenger numbers increased after the city reduced bus fares.

Avoid excessive connectors

Não transforme resumo em:

Firstly…

Secondly…

Moreover…

Furthermore…

se o texto puder ser:

mais direto.

Nominalization

Pode ajudar a reduzir.

The company expanded internationally.

→

The company’s international expansion…

Mas não exagere.

Concision

Compare:

The reason why many students prefer online courses is because they are able to study at times that are more convenient for them.

Melhor:

Many students prefer online courses because they offer flexible study times.

Remove empty expressions

It is important to say that…

It is interesting to note that…

Em resumo, muitas vezes:

desnecessárias.

Original x concise

Original:

One of the main reasons why people choose to use public transportation is the fact that it can often be less expensive than using a private car.

Conciso:

Many people choose public transport because it can be cheaper than driving.

Accuracy before brevity

Não reduza a ponto de:

alterar o sentido.

Original:

The program helped some participants but had no measurable effect on others.

Ruim:

The program helped participants.

Melhor:

The program helped some participants but showed no measurable effect on others.

Summary of narrative

Em narrativas, preserve:

main events

não todos os detalhes.

Original:

Alex missed the bus, walked back home, called a taxi, waited twenty minutes and finally arrived at the airport just before check-in closed.

Resumo:

After missing his bus, Alex took a taxi and reached the airport just before check-in closed.

Summary of process

Preserve:

major stages.

Original:

First the samples are collected, then labeled, stored at low temperature, transported to the laboratory and analyzed.

Resumo:

Samples are collected, prepared and then analyzed in a laboratory.

Summary of comparison

Original:

Online learning offers flexibility, while classroom learning provides more direct interaction.

Resumo:

Online and classroom learning differ mainly in flexibility and direct interaction.

Summary of advantages/disadvantages

Remote work saves commuting time but may reduce face-to-face interaction with colleagues.

Isso já funciona como:

concise summary.

Summary of argument

Identifique:

claim

main reasons

conclusion.

Texto:

Cities should invest in public transport because it can reduce congestion, improve access to services and lower pollution.

Resumo:

The writer argues that cities should invest in public transport because of its transport, accessibility and environmental benefits.

Preservar posição do autor
